title: Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards 2024-25
text:
President Droupadi Murmu presented the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships and Akademi Puraskars for 2024 and 2025 at Vigyan Bhawan in New Delhi on 13 August 2026. A total of 115 artists were honoured across the two award cycles, covering disciplines such as Hindustani music, Carnatic music, Bharatanatyam, Kathak and theatre.

Seven artists were named Fellows of the Akademi. They are Ramlal Bareth, A V Anand, Rita Ganguly, Puru Dadheech, Chittaranjan Jyotishi, Pasumarthi Rattaiah Sarma and Sudharani Raghupathy. The remaining honourees received the Akademi Puraskar. Each Fellow receives a purse of Rs 3 lakh, a Tamrapatra and an Angavastram, while each Puraskar awardee receives Rs 1 lakh with the same honours.

The Sangeet Natak Akademi is the national academy for music, dance and drama. Its fellowships and awards recognise artists for their sustained contribution to the performing arts.

questions.q: Under which Union ministry does the Sangeet Natak Akademi function as an autonomous body?
options: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
questions.explanation: The Sangeet Natak Akademi is an autonomous body of the Ministry of Culture and is funded by the Government for its schemes and programmes.

questions.q: Which of the following is India's national academy of art?
questions.explanation: Lalit Kala Akademi (National Academy of Art) was inaugurated in New Delhi on 5 August 1954. Sahitya Akademi promotes literature and Sangeet Natak Akademi covers music, dance and drama.

questions.q: In which year was the Dadasaheb Phalke Award instituted by the Government of India?
questions.explanation: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award was instituted by the Government of India in 1969, the birth centenary year of Dadasaheb Phalke. Devika Rani was its first recipient.

questions.assertion: The Jnanpith Award is given for a writer's overall contribution to literature.
questions.reason: The Bharatiya Jnanpith sponsors the Jnanpith Award.
questions.explanation: Both statements are true. The award moved from a single work to a writer's overall contribution in 1982, but sponsorship by Bharatiya Jnanpith does not explain why the award is given for overall contribution.

statements: 1. The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is presented by the President of India.
2. The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is administered by the Directorate of Film Festivals.
3. The Saraswati Samman was instituted in 1984.
4. The Sahitya Akademi was founded in 1959.
questions.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because the Saraswati Samman was set up in 1991. Statement 4 is incorrect because Sahitya Akademi was inaugurated on 12 March 1954. Exactly two statements are correct, so the answer is Only two.

statements: I. Akademi Ratna is the highest honour conferred by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
II. Devika Rani was the first recipient of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award.
III. Raja Harishchandra, India's first feature film, was released in 1931.
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are correct. Statement III is incorrect because Raja Harishchandra was released in 1913, so only I and II are correct.
